chapter: Thomas, own bands and neighborhood clubs
title: Where Barnes lived and the Young Imperial band
summary: Barnes tries to place his addresses and recalls the Imperial Band with his cousins, a drummer and a trumpeter.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: This is Rio 4, Emil Vaughn, January 3, 1962. Okay, let's see. I wanted to straighten this

out. You moved from Piety and Claiborne to where? Piety and Claiborne, well, really I don't exactly remember. You were young, huh? Yeah, I was quite young, but I think it was around Pote. Pote Street between Robson and Viveri. Yeah, I think it was around there. And how long did you stay there? Oh, we stayed there for years. Yeah, for years we stayed there. But when you started playing music, where were you living? When I started to play music, I was living on Viveri between Spain and Senran. Viveri between Spain and

year? Well, Billington, right? I moved. I don't remember. Yeah, I couldn't tell you that.
Well, who were you playing with when you moved away from there? Do you remember by any chance?

Yeah, we had a band. The Imperial Band. You were playing with the Imperial? Yeah. Imperial Band. Young Imperial. And who had that band? Well, we had that band that was Simon. My cousin Simon and John. Then we had my cousin Sugar New was playing drum with us. Sugar New, huh? Yeah. What was his last name? Sam Fraser. Oh, Sam? Sam Fraser. Well, I heard of him, but I never heard of Sugar New. Well, that's his nickname. Big name. Yeah. I see. But his right name is Sam Fraser. And who'd you say the trumpet was? The trumpet was this boy, Robert Taylor. Mm-hmm. He was a trumpet player. I don't know what become him. I think he went away, too. Mm-hmm. Well, that's what I meant. In fact, I don't remember so good as all that.
Trombone player, you must have had it. Maybe a violin player, too.
No, we didn't have any violin. No, but I don't know. No, I don't believe we had any trombone. No, we didn't have any trombone. So where did you move to from there, you said?

So Seminar, I moved to... where I am, or whatever. Let's see, I just remember that. I was with Spain and Villeri. Right at the corner, I don't see. Spain and Villeri. Yeah. Yeah.
